description:
Make Every Experience Matter  

 

Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients. By combining proprietary technology — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron, and Lexi — with agentic AI and strategic consulting, we support the full content lifecycle: from creation and MLR validation to localization and omnichannel publishing. Our clients include Top 50 life sciences, pharma, biotech, and medtech companies around the globe.  

\n


Responsibilities:
•    Data analysis and report development on requests from internal and external customers.
•    Providing expert assistance in developing algorithms and methods for calculating report indicators.
•    Develop and implement algorithms and mechanisms for verifying report data.
•    Analysis and development of data download procedures for reports, development of optimization proposals.
•    Development of proposals to improve the functionality of already created reports.
•    Writing and maintaining up-to-date documentation on the developed functionality. 
•    Participates in restoring the system performance in case of failures and non-standard situations.    
•    Writing articles on the developed functionality


Requirements:
•    2 years of experience. 
•    Good knowledge of the functionality of the modelling instruments. 
•    Good knowledge and experience in Excel. 
•    Good knowledge of data analysis 
•    Good knowledge and experience work with databases 
•    Good understanding and applying the principles of the API and REST API. 
•    Knowledge of Python or other instruments. 
•    Analyses and handles all functional tasks of intermediate complexity, able to perform challenging tasks by researching the topic, can design functionality of working instruments.
•    Collaboration with internal customers and planning. 
•    Utilizing formal and informal written communication methods (for example, emails, newsletters, PowerPoint presentations, executive updates, task lists, updates) to communicate updates and findings"".
•    Requirements description in Agile format: Epic, Story, ""Given-When-Then"" scenarios.
•    Ability to interpret information in the free form of models, diagrams and tables.
•    English Upper-intermediate level.
